title: setaria pilifera
intro: Setaria pilifera, commonly known as Black Millet or Bristle Grass, is a type of annual grass belonging to the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Setaria pilifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
